steps: Peel and finely dice the Onion; mince the Garlic cloves.
Rinse the Cooked white beans under cold water and drain well.
Heat Olive oil in a large, deep skillet over medium heat.
Add Onion and Garlic; cook for 3 to 4 minutes, until softened and translucent.
Stir in Ground cumin and Sweet paprika; cook for 30 seconds, until fragrant.
Add Rice, Crushed tomatoes and Unsalted vegetable broth; stir to combine.
Bring to a gentle boil, then cover and cook on low heat for 15 minutes, until rice is tender and liquid is absorbed.
Stir in Cooked white beans and Spinach; cook uncovered for 2 minutes, until spinach wilts.
Remove from heat and mash a few beans with the back of a spoon for a creamier texture suitable for babies.
Serve warm. Yields about 4 family portions. Refrigerate leftovers in an airtight container for up to 3 days.
